lessons: A candidate-free cache must eventually re-evaluate while preserving pending/attempt/budget authority; zero requests during failure is not successful restoration.
Updating a version entry gate without its positive mode/cap/metadata branches is insufficient; tests must catch current-version paths before Native use.
Ordinary Lua51 compilation does not prove a combined diagnostic fits the200-local limit. Avoid unnecessary top-level bindings and validate real combined consumers.
Keep exact current metadata assertions dynamic while retaining historical template/hash and Native-independent scope.
Use the actual discovery/import root required by existing test harnesses; failed module loading is owner tooling, not a product behavior result.
